text: Two removals break code this week: #12290 deletes CLEAN27 code from Service Management across W1 and many localizations, including obsolete ES and IT objects, and #12293 does the same for Warehouse, so extensions still using those elements must be updated. Among behaviour changes, #12198 fixes inconsistent Source Currency on G/L entries for LCY and cash postings, #12141 corrects project ledger costs for non-deductible VAT in a foreign-currency project, and #11848 includes foreign currency opening balances in report 11564. Manufacturing fixes cover finishing orders with rounding differences (#11959), reserved quantities after planning (#12188), undoing output in a non-base unit (#12059) and #11994. Subscription Billing gets #10446, #10182 and #11637. Shopify fixes are #12260, #12215, #12214 and #12139, plus delivery timestamps in #11604. E-documents add self-billed Peppol export (#11560), a warning before releasing an already sent purchase order (#12306), a visible error for unmatched order responses (#12055) and a German IssueDate fix (#9347). New capabilities include the Copilot trial interface (#12428), billable MCP Data Query Tools (#12207), SharePoint paths with hash and percent characters (#12064), Power BI deployment beyond evaluation companies (#12242) and SetReferenceType on SignedXml (#10212). Performance work covers Excel export (#12078) and the dimension upgrade (#12307). BCQuality added knowledge articles, including #213 and #215.

issues: #11994 is cited with no description; it fixes copying production planning lines to a requisition worksheet via Carry Out Action Msg. - Plan.
The Subscription Billing (#10446, #10182, #11637) and Shopify (#12260, #12215, #12214, #12139) numbers are listed without saying what they fix, which makes them less useful to readers.
'the dimension upgrade' for #12307 is vague; it is the set-based DataTransfer backfill of Default Dimension ParentId.
#11604 is flagged as a feature, not a fix, though the word 'plus' partly separates it from the Shopify fixes.
Some behaviour changes are left out (e.g. #11629 SAF-T, #12213 financial report preview, #11748 excise bonded locations); this is a choice of what to include, not an error.
